-- Generate inspection data for 5 days (5 days * 24 hours * 6 machines * ~5 inspections per hour = ~3600 records)
INSERT INTO product_inspections (serialNumber, productModelId, machineId, inspectionTime, overallResult, createdAt)
SELECT 
  CONCAT('SN-', DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL seq.n HOUR), '%Y%m%d%H'), '-', m.id, '-', FLOOR(RAND() * 1000)) as serialNumber,
  1 as productModelId,
  m.id as machineId,
  DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL seq.n HOUR) as inspectionTime,
  CASE 
    WHEN RAND() < 0.85 THEN 'OK'
    WHEN RAND() < 0.95 THEN 'NG'
    ELSE 'NTF'
  END as overallResult,
  DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL seq.n HOUR) as createdAt
FROM machines m
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT a.n + b.n * 10 + c.n * 100 as n
  FROM (SELECT 0 as n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) a
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 as n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) b
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 as n UNION SELECT 1) c
) seq
WHERE seq.n < 120
ORDER BY RAND()
LIMIT 3000;
